notes.title: Checkpoints Patch! (8/20/22 update)
notes.content:
What's new:
-Checkpoints are now live! Restart from a checkpoint after they are encountered when you die!
-Improved contrast between animals and background.

notes.title: Small Update 5/19/2022
notes.content:
-Updated main menu level select with collected frog label and secret level unlock arrow
-Updated level 13 to prevent completing puzzle while in spirit mode
-Fixed flower hitbox size
-Misc small bug fixes

notes.title: Micro Update 4/30/2022
notes.content: -Fixed bug with tree object movement where player could pickup tree by middle or end of tree and move.

notes.title: Small Update 4/26/2022
notes.content:
-Updated locations of Capy the Capybara on Level 2 & 12
-Updated text hints on some Capy locations
-Updated Mandrake location on Level 10 to reduce likelihood of accidental trigger
-Added blink to Secret Level icon on level select menu once unlocked

notes.title: Minor Update 4/21/2022
notes.content:
-Fixed background misalignment Level 6
-Correct cartoon Euka animation Level 10+

notes.title: Update Notes 4/19/2022
notes.content:
Ninja update:
1) The new health meter design is complete! The new design is easier to read and takes up less space.
2) Redesigned Level 2 tutorial to be more straight forward and introduce mechanics more seamlessly.
3) Penny has an easier to see design.

Previous update:
1) You can now switch between cartoon Boris and Realistic FMV style Boris! Along with this, Euka and Capy also change
2) Capy now has a new design, check him out! Capy the Capybara provides helpful tips and overall look cute
3) Improved contrast between falling platform and chandalier against background

notes.title: Update Notes 3/27/2022
notes.content:
-Fixed unskippable cut-scene bug where cursor wasn't visible.
-Level 2 tutorial concerning snakes in spirit realm has been updated so tutorial always shows while in snake zone.

Additional fixes covered:
-Fixed bug with mandrake that caused blurriness at start of attachment to player.
-Updated Level 9 so that player falls into level and music changes once bear boss is beaten.
-Updated Euka the Koala to have text box for character to help with story.

notes.title: Update Notes 3/20/2022
notes.content:
-Increased Boris' speed during crawling/climbing
-Improved Level 2 tutorial
-Improved level designs to multiple levels to reduce likelihood of getting stuck and having to start over
-Improved level designs to better telegraph puzzle solutions
-Reduced amount of back/forth on several levels to reduce monotony
-Added 'Penny the healing dog' to all levels 1-13
-Improved colors to several assets to help with contrast
-Liftable objects now blink on first instance where they can be picked up

notes.title: Update Notes 3/16/2022
notes.content:
Added additional "Penny the healing dog" to multiple levels.
Increased attack hit box size.
Reduced dash attack cool down time.
Updated UI health meter to be more prominent.
Improved tutorial and level designs on multiple levels.

notes.title: Update Notes 3/10/22
notes.content:
-Added partial controller support
-Fixed small bug in Boris where he would stick to walls while falling
-Updated many levels to improve playability and puzzles

notes.title: Update Notes 3/8/2022
notes.content:
Added tutorial to Level 1 for "Penny the Dog" and her healing powers.
Added additional Pennys so all jungle levels have a Penny available.
Updated menu scrolling for credits and sloth facts sub-menus.
